facts.fact: Malawi's MACRA Director General Daudi Suleman said the cyber crimes and cyber security bills had been submitted to the Ministry of Justice awaiting parliamentary review.
facts.system: Cyber crimes and cyber security bills

MWI.note: The bills passed a public stakeholders stage but the document does not say it was online.

facts.fact: The cyber crimes, cyber security, e-evidence and e-transaction bills are reported to have passed the public stakeholders stage before going to the Ministry of Justice.
